subject: Exec action briefing: ops handoffs & QBR readiness
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: leadership@redwood.ai; jonas_weber@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Exec action briefing: ops handoffs & QBR readiness

Team — sending a concise readout ahead of Monday's leadership sync. Short bullets (wins, risks, asks) plus two operational handoffs we need agreed by EOD Monday so the QBR pack can be finalized. I pulled the attached slide deck with the latest metrics and a draft SLA request for Acme.

Wins:
- Hosted API P50 latency improved by 12% this sprint due to batching changes; we validated no quality regression on our eval set (small sample).
- Dedicated capacity pilot for the fintech customer completed smoke tests; can sustain 120rps at target latency.

Risks / open items:
- Acme Analytics procurement pushed timeline by one week — they asked for an updated SLA doc (attached) and price clarification. If we accept their SLA tweak we need approval to extend the dedicated capacity window.
- Two inferred regressions in generation quality on long-form prompts (seen in Canary). Research suggests a kernel fallback introduced a numerical precision edge case; mitigation requires a small config tweak and a scheduled restart of the canary cluster. Restart window needs ops approval (10–15 min).

Asks (actionable):
1) Jonas: confirm go/no-go on a rolling canary restart Monday 10:45–11:00 PT. If yes, please confirm rollback criteria (I suggest 5% uplift in KL divergence on the eval set OR >1% user-facing failure rate).
2) Laura: approve the SLA changes in SLA_request_v2.docx for Acme so we can unblock procurement (see redlined section on data retention). If you want alternate language, suggest edits inline and I’ll re-run legal.
3) Vanessa: please own the QBR slide finalization — I assigned the appendix tables to you in the deck (tab:appendix-metrics). Need the final deck by EOD Monday.

Attachments: QBR_prep_slide-deck.pdf (draft, includes metrics appendix), SLA_request_v2.docx (redlines).

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
VP, Operations
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: leadership@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec action briefing: ops handoffs & QBR readiness

Kim — quick read, thanks. I support the planned rolling restart; agree with your rollback triggers but suggest lowering the KL threshold to 4% (more conservative given customer-facing models). I can run the restart and monitor telemetry.

Two notes:
- Can we schedule a pre-restart smoke check at 10:30 PT (5 min) to confirm KV cache health?
- If we see degradation during the restart, I'll cut the rollout and fail back to the previous kernel version; I will notify the leadership distro immediately.

I'll be on standby Monday.

— Jonas
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>; laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 11:10:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Exec action briefing: ops handoffs & QBR readiness

Forwarding Jonas' note and adding a clarification for Laura on the SLA redline.

Laura — the redline in SLA_request_v2.docx is focused on two items Acme requested: 1) 30-day retention for request-level logs (their security/compliance), and 2) a 99.9% monthly uptime target with credits for degradations beyond our standard plan. Legal flagged the retention language; my recommended compromise is: keep 30-day retention but limit exported log content to metadata + rolling sampling for PII-sensitive fields. That preserves Acme's audit need while limiting scope for our compliance team. If you agree, I will present that compromise to their procurement team tomorrow.

Also tagging the QBR schedule: I propose we keep the ops slide to 6 slides (handoff, performance, incidents, mitigations, cost delta, asks). Vanessa, please confirm you can compress to 6.

--
Kim
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>; jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai; leadership@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec action briefing: ops handoffs & QBR readiness

Thanks for the concise briefing, Kim. I approve the following:
- SLA compromise as you described (30-day retention limited to metadata + sampled fields) — greenlight to present to Acme. Please loop Legal after you send the proposed language so they can sign off quickly.
- Rolling canary restart: approve with Jonas' plan and rollback triggers; proceed with pre-check at 10:30 PT and restart at 10:45 PT.

Vanessa: thank you for taking the deck; please include a one-slide risk summary and call out the Acme timeline slip in the QBR appendix.

I'll attend the Monday sync and will be available for a quick decision if any of the rollback triggers fire.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Chief of Staff, GTM & Ops
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
